scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and primary call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Navigate to the landing page URL
steps.context: User accesses the MirDB landing page for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains the product name 'MirDB', tagline about persistent key-value store with memcached compatibility, and visible CTA buttons
steps.context: Content should be visible within first viewport without scrolling

steps.description: Ensure primary action buttons are clickable and link to appropriate destinations (documentation, source code)
steps.context: Buttons should have clear hover states and be keyboard accessible

test_cases.expected: Hero section displays with 'MirDB' as headline
Tagline contains 'persistent key-value store' and 'memcached compatibility'

test_cases.input: Count CTA buttons in hero section
test_cases.expected: At least 2 primary CTA buttons present (e.g., Get Started, View on GitHub)

test_cases.input: Verify hero section loads within 2 seconds
test_cases.expected: Hero content visible within 2 seconds on standard connection

test_cases.expected: Feature card present explaining memcached protocol support with existing client compatibility

test_cases.input: Query features section for persistence feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card present explaining data persistence, SSTables, and durability

test_cases.input: Verify feature cards have visual icons
test_cases.expected: Each feature card has an associated icon or visual element

scenarios.name: Commands Reference Section
scenarios.description: Verify the commands reference section lists all supported memcached commands and MirDB-specific commands

steps.description: Scroll or use navigation to reach the commands reference section
steps.context: User needs to verify command compatibility with existing memcached code

steps.description: Check that SET, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND commands are listed
steps.context: These are standard memcached storage commands

steps.description: Check that GET and GETS commands are listed
steps.context: These are standard memcached retrieval commands

steps.description: Check that INFO and MAJOR_COMPACTION commands are listed
steps.context: These are MirDB-specific administrative commands

steps.description: Check that response codes documentation is present
steps.context: Users need to understand STORED, NOT_STORED, ERROR responses

test_cases.input: Query commands section for SET command
test_cases.expected: SET command documented with format 'set <key> <flags> <ttl> <bytes>'

test_cases.input: Query commands section for GET command
test_cases.expected: GET command documented with format 'get <key1> [<key2> ...]'

test_cases.input: Query commands section for DELETE command
test_cases.expected: DELETE command documented with format 'delete <key> [noreply]'

test_cases.input: Verify ADD and REPLACE commands present
test_cases.expected: Both ADD and REPLACE commands are listed in commands reference

test_cases.input: Verify APPEND and PREPEND commands present
test_cases.expected: Both APPEND and PREPEND commands are listed in commands reference
INFO command documented as displaying database status
MAJOR_COMPACTION command documented for triggering manual compaction
Response codes STORED, NOT_STORED, EXISTS, NOT_FOUND, DELETED, ERROR documented
